title: Resource methods rejected standard request metadata
description:
Initial new resources/list and resources/read validation rejected standard optional _meta objects, causing valid clients with progress/request metadata to fail. Fixed before delivery by allowing and type-checking optional object metadata only on resource method params, preserving strict tool arguments; regression passed in final34-case native and sanitizer suites; independently reinspected.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261104203810-488c-mcp-agent-guides-004.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
